basics.name: Dr. C. Tufan Cakir
basics.summary: Data Scientist with 7+ years of experience working with complex data, machine learning, statistical modelling, and Python-based analytical software. I combine a background in experimental science with practical experience in building data pipelines, predictive models, automated analysis workflows, databases, and interactive tools. My work focuses on understanding what can reliably be learned from data, validating models under realistic conditions, and turning analysis into robust software that can be used in real workflows.

work.name: IAP, Berlin-Adlershof
work.summary: Developing machine-learning and data-analysis tools for complex experimental and technical datasets, with a focus on robust modelling, structured data workflows, and analytical software.
highlights: Develop machine-learning models for regression and classification problems using complex, multivariate datasets.
Investigate model robustness, feature behaviour, and generalisation across different groups and data domains.
Build reproducible data-processing, feature-engineering, and analysis pipelines in Python.
Develop SQLite-based data structures and interactive analytical applications with Streamlit.
Connect measurement data, automated processing, modelling, visualisation, and laboratory workflows into reusable software tools.

work.name: Bundesanstalt für Materialforschung und -prüfung (BAM)
work.summary: Worked on machine learning, optimisation, automation, and analytical software for experimental and technical systems.
highlights: Developed machine-learning workflows for complex experimental datasets and technical processes.
Built Python software for automated data acquisition, analysis, visualisation, and decision support.
Applied Gaussian processes and Bayesian optimisation to improve experimental search and data-acquisition strategies.
Developed reusable analytical tools and worked closely with interdisciplinary research and engineering teams.

work.name: Bundesanstalt für Materialforschung und -prüfung (BAM)
work.summary: Combined experimental research with Python-based data analysis, statistical modelling, and automated measurement workflows.
highlights: Developed Python pipelines for processing and analysing complex experimental datasets.
Applied statistical and machine-learning methods to prediction, anomaly detection, and measurement optimisation.
Worked with uncertainty, high-dimensional data, automated measurement systems, and real laboratory constraints.
